items.t: Said the COVID-19 gathering limits are intended to assist the healthcare system, allow in-classroom education to continue and keep businesses open.

record.t: Signed an agreement with the Federal Permitting Improvement Steering Council to align Wyoming's permitting timelines with the federal government.
record.q: Federal Permitting Improvement Steering Council (Permitting Council) Executive Director Emily Domenech and Governor Mark Gordon signed an agreement in Cheyenne to get critical infrastructure projects built faster.

record.t: Signed House Bill 01 into law, as Wyoming cut its budget by $430 million.
record.q: Wyoming is eliminating 324 states jobs and cutting its budget by $430 million in response to economic conditions caused by the COVID-19 pandemic and other factors. Gov. Mark Gordon signed House Bill 01 into law earlier this month.

record.t: Was sworn in as governor of Wyoming in January 2019.

record.t: Announced, with the state health officer, limits on public, indoor and outdoor gatherings in Wyoming during the COVID-19 pandemic.
record.q: public gatherings will be limited to 25 people or fewer without restrictions. Indoor gatherings will be limited to 25% capacity with social distancing, and outdoor gatherings will be limited to 50% capacity with social distancing.
